worldcombat.skill.fierydance.summary: Two fire wings unfold as the body spins: from a starting ring around the user they sweep half a turn out to the end radius. Whoever the wing tips sweep takes a Fire hit and is shoved outward. Use movement to lay a wing along an enemy's flank; the gap the wings never sweep can be dodged. A landed dance may raise the user's own Sp. Atk.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.use.0: Spin two fire wings out around the body
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.use.1: Lay a wing edge along an enemy's flank with movement
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.use.2: Burn brighter and raise Sp. Atk on a landed dance
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.description: Each fire wing deals about %1$s special damage when its tip sweeps a foe; the two opposite wings start at a %2$s-block ring around the user. The foe's Sp. Def, type matchup and crits are settled on hit.

Over %2$s the two wings sweep half a turn around the body, their radius opening out to %1$s blocks. Each wing settles each target once (so a target takes at most one hit per wing), shoving it %3$s blocks radially away from the user.
If at least one wing tip lands across the dance, %1$s chance to burn brighter and raise the user's own Sp. Atk by %2$s stage(s) (stat stages, up to +6); at most once per dance.
The dance throws up flames with a wing contact radius of %1$s blocks; the untouched gap between the two wings is never burned, and normal movement during the dance changes the wing paths.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.spiral.on: Spiral dance: the wings open to a larger outer ring and one more Sp. Atk stage on a hit, but each wing hit is lighter and windup, recovery and cooldown are all longer.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.spiral.off: Gathered flame: heavier wing hits, faster and cheaper with a slightly smaller outer ring, but one fewer Sp. Atk stage.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
On: the wings open to a larger outer ring and one more Sp. Atk stage on a hit, but each wing hit is lighter and windup, recovery and cooldown are longer. Off (gathered): heavier wing hits, faster and cheaper with a slightly smaller outer ring, but one fewer Sp. Atk stage.
Only dance when the foe is within this range; it is a body-hugging area move, so a larger value still means closing in first.
On: dance when visible others are clustered around the target so both wings sweep the flanks; those unseen behind walls are not counted. Off: rank it like ordinary melee.
On: while Sp. Atk is below +4 stages, rank the dance higher to build the flame up first. Off: never chase the buff on purpose.
